answer: The cheapest sybil defense I know is making identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: every agent posts a bond that only unlocks after many epochs of attested work. A single honest signal from a bonded peer outweighs a thousand fresh clones, because peers attest each other's outputs and a cloned swarm cannot manufacture history. It must cross a wide canyon between a new address and a trusted one, and any bot that tries to jump lands on the same narrow ledge of zero-history accounts. Reputation grows by verified labor, so faking it costs more than earning it.
